goal: Tile drag and keyboard reorder (I7a, Board gate 189 keyboard reorder): tiles.js with pointer-event drag, Alt+Arrow on the move handle, aria-live announcement, per-dataset order store.

acceptance_criteria.text: app/static/js/tiles.js (local, deferred after dashboard.js in dataset.html): pointerdown on .ws-head or figcaption (not on a button, link, select or input) of tile A and pointerup over tile B moves A into B's place in the DOM (B.before(A) if A came after B, else B.after(A)); .ws-move has touch-action none
Alt+ArrowLeft/ArrowUp on .ws-move moves its tile one place earlier, Alt+ArrowRight/ArrowDown one later; focus stays on the handle; #ws-live text contains '<label> moved to position <i> of <n>'

After each move localStorage['databoot.order.<dataset id>.<app>'] holds the tile keys; on load stored keys come first in stored order and the rest follow in default order; another dataset keeps its default order; Tab order equals visual order

Playwright on the survey fixture (tests/test_tile_interactions.py): drag_to from tile 3's header onto tile 1 changes the data-tile order as specified, a reload keeps it, the monitor dataset keeps its default order; focus .ws-move on tile 2, Alt+ArrowLeft makes it first, #ws-live contains 'position 1 of' and document.activeElement is still the handle
No request leaves the app, no console errors; python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_tile_interactions.py tests/test_survey_page.py passes
Moves acceptance items AC-81, AC-86 forward

decisions.what: Allow drag to start on .ws-move as well as .ws-head/figcaption
decisions.why: Survey tiles have no h2, so the header holds only buttons; touch-action none on the handle implies it is a drag grip

decisions.what: Hit-test pointerup with document.elementFromPoint and no pointer capture
decisions.why: Capture would redirect pointerup to tile A; this works with mouse, touch and Playwright drag_to

decisions.what: Read dataset id and app from .grid[data-dataset][data-app]
decisions.why: All four app templates already emit these attributes, so no template change was needed beyond the script tag

decisions.what: Out-of-range Alt+Arrow does nothing and announces nothing
decisions.why: Announcing 'moved to position' without a move would mislead screen-reader users

assumptions: Only direct .grid > .ws-tile children are reorderable; the expand dialog (another ticket) holds a tile outside the grid, so it is ignored
The failure of test_launcher_folder_is_never_deleted in the full run is unrelated, since the file passes alone
open_questions: tests/test_upload.py::test_launcher_folder_is_never_deleted failed in the full run but passed alone; it may be order-dependent or flaky and should be checked by whoever owns upload

lessons.lesson: Reuse the survey/monitor fixtures and helpers (base, open_, _id) from tests/test_survey_page.py and tests/test_business_page.py for tile tests; and drag_to from a figcaption's title span, not its centre, because the table-toggle button sits in the figcaption
lessons.when: Writing Playwright tests for tile interactions
